t: 30.000 Miles to the Finish / 30.000 Miglia al Traguardo
d: Francesco Cappelletti is on the verge of fulfilling a lifelong dream. He's the only Italian competing in the Golden Globe Race 2018, an around-the-globe single-handed regatta without stops, outside assistance or modern navigational aids. He'll go head-to-head against some of the biggest names in solo sailing along a 30,000-mile race course in some of the world's most treacherous waters.

Michele Sanna is a solo cyclist who loves to travel the world. In "Rwanda Congo Uganda Bike Adventure" he leads us into the heart of Africa, among the forests of the Nyungwe National Park and along the "Congo Nile Trail" in Rwanda, the gorillas and volcanoes of Congo, the Volcano region and the savannah of the Queen Elisabeth National Park in Uganda.
